tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_5.csv')
# leave-one-out: for each row, compute z-score using its group stats excluding that row
rows = []
for (acc, svc), grp in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    for idx, row in grp.iterrows():
        rest = grp['BilledCost']
        rest2 = rest[rest.index != idx]
        m, s = rest2.mean(), rest2.std()
        rows.append((idx, row['ChargePeriodStart'], acc, svc, row['BilledCost'], (row['BilledCost']-m)/s))
lo = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['idx','date','acc','svc','cost','z']).sort_values('z', ascending=False)
print(lo.head(8).to_string())
